The problem

Foundations receive hundreds of applications, most of which are plain text templates that look the same, making it hard for organizations to stand out

What it does

Generate professional, visually compelling, and data-rich application documents that demonstrate fit and transparency

Where it is heading

To become a standalone SaaS product that helps any purpose-driven organization present themselves compellingly to potential funders and generate professional application documents.
